A '''reconnaissance team''' was dispatched by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] occupied [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]]. It was led by a trio of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], and included some [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] warriors.
